crossRefs.note: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be…
Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…
How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!
This also comes out from Yahweh of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
“For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
Yahweh’s anger will not return until he has executed, and until he has performed the intents of his heart. In the…
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
“For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.
That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?
But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

translations.web: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
translations.bsb: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
translations.kjv: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
translations.asv: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.
